question: When \(0.000315\) is multiplied by \(7{,}928{,}564\) the product is closest to which of the following?
solution: Use nearby easy numbers to trap the product in a short interval. Both factors are positive, and \[ 0.0003<0.000315<0.00032, \] \[ 7{,}900{,}000<7{,}928{,}564<8{,}000{,}000. \] Multiplying the two lower bounds gives a smaller product, and multiplying the two upper bounds gives a larger product. If \(P\) is the requested product, then \[ 2370=0.0003\cdot7{,}900{,}000
